findings: Updated 10 rows. 5 rows got specific recruitment/vacancy URLs: Row 52/53/56 -> commerce.gov.in/#/offerings/vacancies (confirmed from Vite React SPA JS bundle route analysis), Row 59 -> teaboard.gov.in/TEABOARDPAGE/MTQ= (actual Vacancy page, corrected from NTRF page MjU=), Row 68 -> dot.gov.in/offerings/vacancies (confirmed from Next.js build manifest). 5 rows retained homepage URLs with documented reasons: Row 62 (tobaccoboard.in - legacy PHP site, no recruitment page, small org), Row 75 (dfpd.gov.in - site unreachable/timeout), Row 77 (dmi.gov.in - 403 WAF blocked), Row 81 (consumeraffairs.gov.in - unreachable/timeout), Row 102 (ansi.gov.in - 403/timeout WAF protected). Many Indian gov sites are now SPAs (Next.js, Vite/React) that cannot be scraped with simple HTTP requests - JS bundle analysis is needed to find routes. Several sites block automated access entirely.
